support_rule: Every material claim on every final surface must be supported by a complete current source excerpt or an active USER fact. Hashes/JSON/source IDs do not prove truth or relevance. Any unsupported claim fails support; incomplete review is unassessed, not success.
question_rule: Ask only a necessary user-answerable current gap. Do not repeat known version, Python, prior checks or the working reduction; a missing document is retrieval/maintainer work. Active evidence facts and prose do not confirm user answers.
operational_rule: At most two attempts/two retrieval rounds/two queries per round/eight steps. retrieve_more requires actual can_refine. Record reached rounds and incomplete/skipped separately; no scripted planner result is model quality.
scoring_rule: Score decision admissibility, whole-output support and necessary/answerable/nonrepeated questions separately; usefulness human score stays null without independent human judgment. Report per condition/stratum/arm, not an all-escalate-friendly sole aggregate.
